{{External|rsc}} {{otheruses|def=no|longbows in general|Longbow (weapon)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Longbow |image = [[File:Longbow.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A nice sturdy bow. |value = 80 |weight = 1.814 |respawn = 200 |exchange = Yes |id = 839 }} [[File:Longbow detail.png|left|120px]] The basic '''longbow''' is a bow made from regular [[logs]]. It can be equipped at any [[Ranged]] level and can fire [[arrows]] up to [[iron arrow|iron]]. It has a longer range than its [[shortbow]] counterpart, but fires at a slower [[attack speed|speed]]. A longbow can be made at level 10 [[Fletching]] by using a knife on some logs to create a [[longbow (u)]], granting 10 experience, and then using a [[bowstring]] on the unstrung bow, granting another 10 experience. Fletching a longbow from [[logs]] and [[bow string]] will profit {{Coins|{{GEP|Longbow}}-({{GEP|Logs}}+{{GEP|Bow string}})}} while fletching a longbow from a [[longbow (u)]] and [[bow string]] will profit {{Coins|{{GEP|Longbow}}-({{GEP|Longbow (u)}}+{{GEP|Bow string}})}}. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +8 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 6 |attackrange = 10 |combatstyle = Bow |image = [[File:Longbow equipped.png]] |altimage = [[File:Longbow equipped female.png|230px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Bow|speed=6|attackrange=10}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Fletching |skill1lvl = 10 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 10 |members = Yes |ticks = 2 |mat1 = Longbow (u) |mat2 = Bow string |output1 = Longbow }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Longbow}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Longbow}} ===Item spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Longbow|location=[[Ranging Guild]]|members=Yes|2678,3427,qty:1|leagueRegion=Kandarin}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |daterange = 1 – 28 June 2004 |change = The item was recoloured. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Longbow detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Longbow detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Longbow (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Longbow.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
